{{Quote|The spears are ancient defense turrets built into the bedrock. Not up to "modern" specifications--still, more powerful than any walker.|Duke Charle Organa|<ref name="Raise" />}}
The '''Spears of Organa''' were an array of defensive turrets built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] by [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]]. The three turrets were built into the bedrock of the mountains near [[Castle Organa]]. While not up to weapon standards at the time, the Spears were still more powerful than any contemporary [[Walker/Legends|walker]].

==History==
During the [[Alderaan Civil War]], [[Jharkus Thul]] led the army of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] in numerous campaigns against [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] along with its [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] allies. Thul forces attacked the Spears of Organa, intending to capture and use them against Organa Palace and the other Republic allies. The three Spears were designated Spear [[Cresh/Legends|Cresh]], Spear [[Osk/Legends|Osk]], and Spear [[Trill/Legends|Trill]].<ref name="Raise" />

[[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Charle Remmot Organa]] tasked a Republic-allied individual with retaking the Spears from Thul control. However, the individual, the Duke, and General [[Kashim]] of the Republic, were contacted by Jharkus after the individual secured the Spears, who revealed that the attack had simply been a diversion so that his forces could capture three hundred and forty-eight Organa subjects and take them hostage.<ref name="Raise" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Spears of Organa were created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. They appear in the mission "Raising the Flag" for Republic players on Alderaan, where players are asked to defeat ten Thul troops at each of the Spears.<ref name="Raise" />
